verdict.rationale: Highnote has an official Node.js SDK (@highnote-oss/nodejs-sdk) plus several client-side SDKs (Checkout, Secure Inputs, Card Viewer, Document Upload) documented, but the core SDK is explicitly labeled beta and no OpenAPI spec is discoverable (404s), and there's no evidence of SDKs in other major languages or independent developer corroboration. missing for 10: multi-language official SDKs, GA (non-beta) status, OpenAPI/schema artifacts, third-party/hands-on validation of SDK usage.
